changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0041. Record who converted a lead. Index review: FK_Leads_ConvertedByUsers mirrors LostByUserId; no new list index because conversion history is read with the lead by Id. Performance note: nullable ConvertedByUserId does not change IX_Leads_TenantId_Status.

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE app.Leads DROP CONSTRAINT FK_Leads_ConvertedByUsers; ALTER TABLE app.Leads DROP COLUMN ConvertedByUserId;
